full_judgment: We have noticed that the writ petitioners have been fighting for years together for infringement of their rights and status, and this Court could not dispose of the appeals for a long time. However, we are not inclined to take a different view in respect of these writ petitioners due to such delay. Since the writ petitioners can seek reliefs before the Administrative Tribunal, we make it clear that if the writ petitioners desire to redress their grievances before the Administrative Tribunal since they had been prosecuting their grievances in the Supreme Court of Bangladesh for a long time, the Administrative Tribunal shall entertain their petitions, if any, are filed on condoning the delay under section 14 of the Limitation Act.” -----
